description: Call this before you send a payment, or right after a call unexpectedly failed: is this service up right now. With no slug, the directory snapshot: five status counts across 500+ services (include_services=true attaches every row). With a slug: that service's status, its 24h/7d/30d/90d uptime windows, response time, consecutive failures, daily snapshots. No money fields.

include_services.description: Directory mode only (no slug): if true, also attach the full per-service status array. Off by default so a directory health check returns just the five status counts, not every service.

slug.description: Service slug for a single-service health report. Omit for the whole directory.

uptime_period.description: Daily uptime snapshot window for single-service mode.

name: x402_check_health
title: Check x402 service health
